scenarios.fact: Exact events, guests, capacity fixture, and personas exist.
Public preview excludes private host controls and data.
An invited guest records yes/no/maybe and plus-one transitions.
Host, cohost, guest, and outsider have distinct read/write authority.
Guest-list visibility changes independently from public event visibility.
Two concurrent RSVPs for the final seat cannot overbook capacity.
Wall posts and RSVP totals update live during the frozen burst.
Authenticated event art upload, authorized delivery, and deletion work.
A scheduled reminder produces one inspectable idempotent attempt.
A retry does not duplicate a known-success notification.
An ambiguous notification outcome remains distinct and safely retryable.
Revocation or event removal stops protected delivery and handles retained data honestly.
Hosted secret/configuration, effect boundary, logs, and target identity are inspectable.
Frozen contention/burst/asset/realtime/deploy samples and cost window are retained.
Only exact fresh targets or arm-owned namespaced records, assets, schedules, and secrets are retired; unrelated baseline state is preserved.
